fields.name: Email
fields.description: Receives workflow emails and signs in to the Supplier Quality Portal.

fields.name: Role
fields.description: Also the portal role: it decides which pages and buttons a person sees. Supplier quality managers and quality directors can approve corrective actions.

fields.name: Is active
fields.description: Untick when someone leaves. Their past records stay linked.

fields.name: Password
fields.description: Sign-in password for the Supplier Quality Portal (with Email). The template’s demo users use "template": before go-live, delete them or give each its own strong password.

fields.name: Open SCAR count
fields.description: Corrective action requests this person owns that are not closed or cancelled. A workload indicator.
fields.formula: count(filter(field('Owned corrective action'), and(totext(lookup('Owned corrective action', 'Status')) != 'Closed', totext(lookup('Owned corrective action', 'Status')) != 'Cancelled')))

fields.name: Supplier code
fields.description: The vendor number in your ERP. Use it as the key when the ERP writes received quantities through the API.

fields.name: Quantity received (12 months)
fields.description: Parts received from this supplier in the last 12 months. Written by your ERP (or by hand); PPM is calculated from it.

fields.name: Supplier quality engineer
fields.description: Owns this supplier’s nonconformances by default.

fields.name: Portal key
fields.description: Technical: the row IDs of this supplier’s portal-enabled contacts, as ",12,15,". The portal uses it so each supplier only sees its own records.
fields.formula: concat(',', join(filter(totext(lookup('Supplier contact', 'Account ID')), lookup('Supplier contact', 'Is portal enabled')), ','), ',')

fields.name: NCR count (12 months)
fields.description: Nonconformances detected in the last 12 months (cancelled ones left out).

fields.name: Rejected quantity (12 months)
fields.description: Parts rejected on those nonconformances.
fields.formula: sum(filter(lookup('Nonconformance', 'Quantity rejected'), and(lookup('Nonconformance', 'Is within 12 months'), totext(lookup('Nonconformance', 'Status')) != 'Cancelled')))

fields.name: Severity points (12 months)
fields.description: Minor 1, Major 3, Critical 8 points per nonconformance in the last 12 months.
fields.formula: sum(filter(lookup('Nonconformance', 'Severity points'), and(lookup('Nonconformance', 'Is within 12 months'), totext(lookup('Nonconformance', 'Status')) != 'Cancelled')))

fields.name: Open SCAR count
fields.description: Corrective action requests that are not closed or cancelled.
fields.formula: count(filter(field('Corrective action request'), and(totext(lookup('Corrective action request', 'Status')) != 'Closed', totext(lookup('Corrective action request', 'Status')) != 'Cancelled')))

fields.name: SCAR closure rate (%)
fields.description: Share of the corrective action requests issued in the last 12 months that are closed. Empty when none were issued (text, so it can be empty instead of 0).
fields.formula: if(count(filter(field('Corrective action request'), and(lookup('Corrective action request', 'Is issued within 12 months'), totext(lookup('Corrective action request', 'Status')) != 'Cancelled'))) = 0, '', totext(round(count(filter(field('Corrective action request'), and(lookup('Corrective action request', 'Is issued within 12 months'), totext(lookup('Corrective action request', 'Status')) = 'Closed'))) / count(filter(field('Corrective action request'), and(lookup('Corrective action request', 'Is issued within 12 months'), totext(lookup('Corrective action request', 'Status')) != 'Cancelled'))) * 100, 0)))

fields.name: PPM (12 months)
fields.description: Parts per million: rejected quantity ÷ quantity received × 1,000,000. 0 when no received quantity is known.
fields.formula: if(or(isblank(field('Quantity received (12 months)')), field('Quantity received (12 months)') = 0), 0, round(field('Rejected quantity (12 months)') / field('Quantity received (12 months)') * 1000000, 0))

fields.name: Repeat defect count (12 months)
fields.description: Nonconformances in the last 12 months that repeat an earlier defect from this supplier (same part, same defect type).
fields.formula: count(filter(field('Nonconformance'), and(lookup('Nonconformance', 'Is repeat defect'), and(lookup('Nonconformance', 'Is within 12 months'), totext(lookup('Nonconformance', 'Status')) != 'Cancelled'))))

fields.name: Overdue SCAR count
fields.description: Corrective action requests waiting on this supplier past their due date.
fields.formula: count(filter(field('Corrective action request'), lookup('Corrective action request', 'Is overdue')))

fields.name: Average response time (days)
fields.description: Average days from issuing a corrective action request to the supplier’s first 8D report, for requests issued in the last 12 months. Empty when there is nothing to measure (text, so it can be empty instead of 0).
fields.formula: if(count(filter(field('Corrective action request'), and(lookup('Corrective action request', 'Is issued within 12 months'), lookup('Corrective action request', 'Is response received')))) = 0, '', totext(round(avg(filter(lookup('Corrective action request', 'Days to first response'), and(lookup('Corrective action request', 'Is issued within 12 months'), lookup('Corrective action request', 'Is response received')))), 1)))

fields.name: Quality score
fields.description: Starts at 100. Minus severity points (at most 40), minus PPM ÷ 1,000 (at most 20), minus 10 per overdue SCAR (at most 20), minus 5 per repeat defect (at most 20). Never below 0. Change the weights here to match your own scorecard.
fields.formula: greatest(0, 100 - least(40, field('Severity points (12 months)')) - least(20, round(field('PPM (12 months)') / 1000, 0)) - least(20, field('Overdue SCAR count') * 10) - least(20, field('Repeat defect count (12 months)') * 5))

fields.name: Supplier rating
fields.description: A (quality score 85 or more), B (65 to 84), C (below 65). Not rated: no received quantity and no nonconformance in the last 12 months.
fields.formula: if(and(field('NCR count (12 months)') = 0, or(isblank(field('Quantity received (12 months)')), field('Quantity received (12 months)') = 0)), 'Not rated', if(field('Quality score') >= 85, 'A', if(field('Quality score') >= 65, 'B', 'C')))

fields.name: Subject
fields.description: One line the supplier sees in emails and in the portal.

fields.name: Problem statement
fields.description: What went wrong, as the supplier should read it.

fields.name: Extension (days)
fields.description: Extra days granted to the supplier for the full 8D.

fields.name: Verification note
fields.description: How effectiveness was checked (lots inspected, results).

fields.name: Supplier contact
fields.description: Who at the supplier receives this request. Their colleagues with portal access see it too.

fields.name: Owner
fields.description: The supplier quality engineer who reviews the supplier’s 8D reports.

fields.name: Approved by
fields.description: Second person who approves the accepted 8D (four-eyes). Must not be the owner.

fields.name: Containment due
fields.description: Issued on + 2 days: the supplier confirms containment (D1–D3) with a first 8D report.

fields.name: Response due
fields.description: Issued on + 30 days + extension: the complete 8D report is due.
fields.formula: field('Issued on') + date_interval('30 days') + date_interval('1 day') * field('Extension (days)')

fields.name: Verification due
fields.description: Approved on + 60 days: by then, the team confirms the corrective action works.

fields.name: Is issued within 12 months
fields.description: Issued in the last 12 months (used by the supplier scorecard).

fields.name: Is reopen needed
fields.description: Technical guard: verified not effective while verifying, so the request goes back to the supplier.

fields.name: First response on
fields.description: When the supplier’s first 8D report arrived.

fields.name: Is four-eyes check passed
fields.description: An approver is set and is not the owner.

fields.name: Days to first response
fields.description: Days from Issued on to the first 8D report.
fields.formula: date_diff('dd', field('Issued on'), field('First response on'))

fields.name: Is overdue
fields.description: Waiting on the supplier (Issued or Changes requested) and either no 8D report after Containment due, or past Response due.
fields.formula: and(or(totext(field('Status')) = 'Issued', totext(field('Status')) = 'Changes requested'), or(and(isblank(field('First response on')), today() > field('Containment due')), today() > field('Response due')))

fields.name: Is approval to apply
fields.description: Technical guard for the Approval workflow.
fields.formula: and(field('Is four-eyes check passed'), totext(field('Status')) = 'Awaiting approval')

fields.name: Is ready to close
fields.description: Technical guard for the closing workflow: verified effective, still verifying, approved by a second person.
fields.formula: and(totext(field('Effectiveness result')) = 'Effective', and(totext(field('Status')) = 'Verifying effectiveness', field('Is four-eyes check passed')))

fields.name: Portal key
fields.description: Technical: the supplier’s portal key, so the portal only shows this request to that supplier.

fields.name: Days overdue
fields.formula: if(field('Is overdue'), if(today() > field('Response due'), date_diff('dd', field('Response due'), today()), date_diff('dd', field('Containment due'), today())), 0)

fields.name: Escalation level
fields.description: 0 none · 1 = 1–7 days overdue (reminder to the supplier) · 2 = 8–14 days (quality manager) · 3 = more than 14 days (procurement).
fields.formula: if(field('Days overdue') > 14, 3, if(field('Days overdue') > 7, 2, if(field('Days overdue') > 0, 1, 0)))
